title: Watch Polar Bears Live in Canada
summary:
Fat Bear Week in Alaska is over, but you can still watch bears online! Two groups, Explore.org and Polar Bears International, run eight live cameras in Churchill, Canada. Churchill is called the polar bear capital of the world.

In October and November, polar bears gather by Hudson Bay. They wait for the sea ice to freeze. When the ice is thick enough, they walk out onto it to hunt seals.

The cameras help scientists, too. In December 2025, scientists confirmed that a mother polar bear had adopted a cub that was not hers. In spring she had one cub with a tag. By fall, she had two cubs, but only one had a tag.

There is more to see. One camera rides on a moving hotel made of buggies linked like a train. At night, another camera shows the colorful northern lights. There is even a camera on a raven nest!
why_it_matters: You can watch real wild polar bears from home and maybe spot something scientists have never seen.

background_read: Polar bears live in the cold Arctic and walk out on sea ice to hunt seals.
Near Hudson Bay in Canada, the ice melts in summer, so the bears wait on land until the water freezes again in the fall.
Article_Structure: WHO: Polar bears, plus the groups Explore.org and Polar Bears International
WHAT: Live cameras show bears waiting for the sea ice to freeze
WHERE: Churchill, Canada, by Hudson Bay
WHY: So people can watch the bears and scientists can learn about them
